title: The Early-Woken Siphon Primer
summary: A primer for the rare mortal whose soul stirs before the Xiantian realm that teaches the first sips of stray soul force and how to keep a thin reserve from leaking.

title: The Soul-Siphon Primer
summary: A primer on siphoning the motes of soul force left by spent techniques and on the soft soaking of a mental push.

title: A Handbook of the Quiet Draw
summary: A handbook on drawing hostile soul force by small degrees and storing it without strain.

title: The Plain Cistern Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book on holding a cistern of soul force in the chest that fills from spill and empties in a short burst.

title: Workbook of the Banked Wick
summary: A workbook on banking drawn force low in the soul like a wick and fanning it up when the next technique needs it.

title: The Tithe-Taker's Handbook
summary: A handbook on levying a small tithe from every hostile soul force that touches the user and returning it as one clean jolt.
